jobDescription:
🚀 ARE YOU A 10X ROCKSTAR NINJA WIZARD? 🌟
Come crush code with us at DisruptiveHyperScale! We play ping pong, drink cold brew on tap, and change the universe every Tuesday!

Perks & Culture:
- Unlimited PTO (we mean it!)
- Free kombucha and catered taco Tuesdays
- Pet-friendly dog park in the office kitchen
- Annual company retreat to Bali

What you will bring to the vibe:
- Must know React and Next.js deeply (at least 3 years building web apps)
- Must have rock-solid TypeScript skills and know how to use strict typing
- Hands-on experience with Tailwind CSS for rapid modern styling
- Ability to work in a fast-paced agile environment with good energy

Equal Opportunity Employer:
We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity, genetic information, or favorite code editor. All applicants welcome! Submit your portfolio today!
resumeText:
Sam Chen
Frontend Software Engineer
Email: sam.chen@example.com | GitHub: github.com/schen-frontend

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Frontend engineer with 4 years of experience building scalable, accessible, and responsive user interfaces using React, Next.js, and TypeScript.

SKILLS
Languages: TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3
Frameworks: React 18, Next.js (App Router), Tailwind CSS, Redux Toolkit
Testing: Vitest, React Testing Library, Playwright

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Frontend Engineer | SaaSify Solutions | 2022 - Present
- Engineered web application using Next.js 14 App Router and TypeScript, serving 500k monthly active users.
- Implemented responsive design system using Tailwind CSS with automated dark mode and WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility compliance.
- Wrote comprehensive end-to-end and component tests using Playwright and React Testing Library.

Junior UI Developer | PixelPulse | 2020 - 2022
- Developed interactive customer onboarding flows in React and TypeScript.
- Refactored legacy CSS into modular Tailwind utility classes.
